name: n8n_create_workflow
description: Create a new n8n workflow from a JSON definition. Returns the new workflow's ID. Gated: requires user confirmation unless auto-mode is on.
expected_effect: Creates a new workflow in the connected n8n instance. The workflow is inactive by default unless the payload sets active=true. Reversible by deleting the new workflow.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Display name for the new workflow

parameters.name: nodes
parameters.description: Node objects (id, name, type, typeVersion, position, parameters)

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description: Node connection map keyed by source node name
